message.reasoning:
The user wants to retrieve only the IDs and context attributes of community comments for domain test4.org using continuation cursor cur456 and API key key123. They want to use the GraphQL endpoint. We need to construct a GraphQL query. The query should request communityComments with fields id and context. The query should include domain filter and continuationCursor. Also we need to set the Authorization header with Bearer key123. So we need to produce an HTTP request. The user didn't ask for code but presumably they want instructions or a sample request. We can provide a curl command or a fetch example. The user might want to know how to do it. So we can give them a curl command:

curl -X POST https://api.example.com/graphql \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer key123" \
-d '{"query":"query { communityComments(domain:\"test4.org\", continuationCursor:\"cur456\") { id context } }"}'

We can also mention that the response will contain data.communityComments array. Provide explanation.
